english.note: Use this for something worth a lot of money, especially an item or possession.
Use 值錢 when emphasizing that something has monetary or exchange value, rather than whether an action is worthwhile.

examples.jyutping: ni1 zek3 gau6 biu1 hou2 zik6 cin2

examples.english: This old watch is still worth money, so we can take it to auction.
examples.traditional: 呢隻舊手錶仲值錢，可以拎去拍賣。
examples.jyutping: ni1 zek3 gau6 sau2 biu2 zung6 zik6 cin2 ho2 ji5 ling1 heoi3 paak3 maai6
